codeFiles.pyproject.toml:
[project]
name = "albedo"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Albedo subnet: backend eval/validation/chain-reader services + the miner `albedo` CLI."
requires-python = ">=3.11"
license = { text = "MIT" }
dependencies = [
    "asyncpg>=0.29",
    "bittensor>=10.3,<11",
    "boto3>=1.35.0",
    "datasets",
    "fastapi>=0.115.0",
    "hf_transfer>=0.1",
    "hippius-hub==0.6.0",
    "httpx>=0.27.0",
    "huggingface-hub==1.19.0",
    "loguru>=0.7",
    "numpy",
    "opensearch-py>=2,<3",
    "pandas",
    "pre-commit",
    "prompt_toolkit>=3",
    "psycopg[binary]>=3.2.0",
    "pydantic>=2.8.0",
    "pydantic-settings>=2.4.0",
    "pyarrow>=16.0.0",
    "pytest>=8.2.0",
    "ruff",
    "safetensors",
    "torch==2.11.0",
    "torchaudio==2.11.0",
    "torchvision==0.26.0",
    "transformers==5.11.0",
    "uvicorn[standard]>=0.30.0",
    "vllm==0.23.0",
    "pynacl>=1.6.2",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
# Miner-side SFT/RL training.
train = ["trl", "accelerate", "deepspeed"]

[project.scripts]
albedo-eval-api = "albedo_eval_service.control.api:main"
albedo-eval-dispatcher = "albedo_eval_service.control.dispatcher:main"
albedo-eval-requeuer = "albedo_eval_service.control.requeuer:main"
set-reign-worker = "set_reign_worker.service:main"
weight-setter = "weight_setter.service:main"
albedo-remote-eval-api = "albedo_eval_service.remote.api:main"
albedo-judge-api = "albedo_eval_service.judge_api:main"
albedo-repo-context-api = "repo_context_service.api:main"
albedo-score-bridge = "albedo_eval_service.scoring.score_bridge_client:main"
chain-reader = "chain_reader.reader:main"
access-controller = "private_store.controller:main"
model-validation = "model_validation.validate_worker:main"
sanity-remote = "sanity_remote.api:main"
sanity-dispatcher = "sanity_service.dispatcher:main"
albedo = "miner.cli:main"

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = [
    "src/albedo_config",
    "src/albedo_eval_service",
    "src/repo_context_service",
    "src/set_reign_worker",
    "src/weight_setter",
    "src/chain_reader",
    "src/chain_guard",
    "src/config_validation",
    "src/model_validation",
    "src/private_store",
    "src/sanity_service",
    "src/sanity_remote",
    "miner",
]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
pythonpath = ["src"]
testpaths = ["tests"]
markers = [
    "integration: requires ALBEDO_TEST_DATABASE_URL and a Postgres database initialized from schema.sql",
]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py311"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "W", "F", "I"]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
# Judge prompts are long-form prose inside string literals; line length is not meaningful there.
"src/sanity_service/rubric.py" = ["E501"]
"src/albedo_eval_service/judge/prompt_judge.py" = ["E501"]
"src/albedo_eval_service/evaluator/reference/prompt_reference_split.py" = ["E501"]
"src/albedo_eval_service/evaluator/behavior/prompt_behavior.py" = ["E501"]
"src/albedo_eval_service/simulator/prompt_simulator.py" = ["E501"]
"src/albedo_eval_service/shared/submit_protocol.py" = ["E501"]
"src/albedo_eval_service/remote/prompt_remote.py" = ["E501"]
"src/repo_context_service/core.py" = ["E501"]
"src/sanity_service/chain.py" = ["E501"]
# Embedded SQL strings dominate the repository; line length is not meaningful there.
"src/albedo_eval_service/control/repository.py" = ["E501"]
"src/sanity_service/db.py" = ["E501"]
"src/chain_reader/db.py" = ["E501"]
"tests/integration/test_eval_repository_postgres.py" = ["E501"]
# Imports deliberately follow sys.path / environment setup in these entry points.
"scripts/dataset_creator/pipeline.py" = ["E402"]
"scripts/manual_dedup_h2h.py" = ["E402"]
"chat_to_king/supervisor.py" = ["E402"]
"tests/test_sanity_gate.py" = ["E402"]
# Availability probe: the import itself is the feature test, inside try/except ImportError.
"src/albedo_eval_service/modelstore/resolver.py" = ["F401"]
"src/config_validation/storage/_fastdl.py" = ["F401"]
# Long lines sit inside multi-line SQL/HTML literals, where a noqa comment would
# become part of the string.
"scripts/create_genesis_king.py" = ["E501"]
"scripts/dataset_creator/db.py" = ["E501"]
"scripts/dataset_creator/viewer.py" = ["E501"]
"src/model_validation/db.py" = ["E501"]
codeFiles.docker-compose.yml:
services:
  albedo-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: albedo-eval-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${ALBEDO_POSTGRES_USER}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${ALBEDO_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${ALBEDO_POSTGRES_DB}
    ports:
      - "${ALBEDO_POSTGRES_HOST_PORT}:5432"
    volumes:
      - albedo-postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${ALBEDO_POSTGRES_USER} -d ${ALBEDO_POSTGRES_DB}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20

volumes:
  albedo-postgres-data:
codeFiles..env.example_miners:
# Albedo MINER configuration.
#
# Copy this file to `.env` (in the albedo repo root) and fill in your values:
#     cp .env.example_miners .env
#
# Every value here is optional — it just sets a default so you can omit the matching
# CLI flag. Real environment variables and CLI flags always override these
# (e.g. `CHAIN_NETWORK=test albedo check-commit` or `albedo commit --hotkey other`).

# --- Bittensor wallet -------------------------------------------------------
# Lets you run `albedo register / commit / publish` without --coldkey/--hotkey.
ALBEDO_COLDKEY=
ALBEDO_HOTKEY=
# Only set this if your wallets are NOT in the default ~/.bittensor/wallets dir.
# ALBEDO_WALLET_PATH=/home/you/.bittensor/wallets

# --- Subnet / chain ---------------------------------------------------------
CHAIN_NETUID=97
CHAIN_NETWORK=finney

# --- Model upload backend ---------------------------------------------------
# HF is primary; set ALBEDO_MODEL_BACKEND=hippius to upload to Hippius instead.
ALBEDO_MODEL_BACKEND=hf

# --- HuggingFace (primary model upload/download) ----------------------------
HF_TOKEN=
# Xet is the live HF fast-transfer path (huggingface_hub>=1.0); hf_transfer is inert.
HF_XET_HIGH_PERFORMANCE=1

# --- Hippius (model upload — option) ----------------------------------------
# Use a token, OR a username + password (the token wins if both are set).
HIPPIUS_HUB_TOKEN=
# HIPPIUS_HUB_USERNAME=
# HIPPIUS_HUB_PASSWORD=

# --- Repo naming ------------------------------------------------------------
# Your Hippius namespace (the part before the slash). With this set you can omit
# --namespace; `--name v1` then builds `<namespace>/albedo-qwen3.6-35b-v1`.
ALBEDO_NAMESPACE=
# Leave the prefix as-is unless the subnet changes it.
ALBEDO_REPO_PREFIX=albedo-qwen3.6-35b

# --- Local cache ------------------------------------------------------------
# Where remote `check-hippius` downloads config.json for inspection.
# ALBEDO_MODEL_CACHE_DIR=/home/you/.cache/albedo_models
codeFiles..env.example:
# Albedo configuration template.
# Env carries only secrets and per-machine topology (hosts, paths, GPU ids, ports).
# Models, providers and all tunables live in code with prod values as defaults
# (albedo_eval_service/judge/models.py and the settings classes); do not add them here.

# ── Postgres (control-plane DB) ──
ALBEDO_POSTGRES_USER=user
# secret
ALBEDO_POSTGRES_PASSWORD=password
ALBEDO_POSTGRES_DB=db
ALBEDO_POSTGRES_HOST=127.0.0.1
ALBEDO_POSTGRES_HOST_PORT=65432

# ── Chain identity (mainnet vs testnet) ──
CHAIN_NETUID=97
CHAIN_NETWORK=finney

# ── Eval control plane (backend host) ──
# secret
ALBEDO_EVAL_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@127.0.0.1:65432/db
# secret; shared bearer for the remote eval API (canonical name: ALBEDO_REMOTE_AUTH_TOKEN)
ALBEDO_EVAL_REMOTE_AUTH_TOKEN=token
ALBEDO_EVAL_DATASET_MANIFEST_URI=s3://bucket/datasets/manifest.json
ALBEDO_EVAL_DATASET_MANIFEST_PATH=path
ALBEDO_EVAL_JUDGE_CONFIG_HASH=sha256:hash

# ── Backend ↔ GPU host SSH tunnel ──
ALBEDO_GPU_HOST_USER=user
ALBEDO_GPU_HOST_SSH_HOST=host

# ── Judge API (backend host) ──
# secret
ALBEDO_JUDGE_API_AUTH_TOKEN=token
# secret
ALBEDO_JUDGE_OPENROUTER_API_KEY=key
# secret; optional second provider (engy routing stays off without it)
ALBEDO_JUDGE_ENGY_API_KEY=
ALBEDO_JUDGE_REPO_CONTEXT_URL=url
ALBEDO_JUDGE_PM2_SCRIPT=path
# Score bridge needs no keys of its own: its tokens fall back to
# ALBEDO_REMOTE_AUTH_TOKEN / ALBEDO_JUDGE_API_AUTH_TOKEN and its URLs default correctly.

# ── Remote eval worker (GPU host) ──
# secret
ALBEDO_REMOTE_AUTH_TOKEN=token
ALBEDO_REMOTE_HOST_ID=host-id
ALBEDO_REMOTE_DATASET_ROOT=path
ALBEDO_REMOTE_MODEL_CACHE_DIR=path
ALBEDO_REMOTE_ARTIFACT_SPOOL_DIR=path
ALBEDO_REMOTE_REMOTE_STATE_DIR=path
ALBEDO_REMOTE_COMPILE_CACHE_DIR=path
ALBEDO_REMOTE_REPO_CONTEXT_URL=url
ALBEDO_REMOTE_EVAL_PM2_SCRIPT=path

# ── Shared S3 / R2 bucket (ALBEDO_REMOTE_S3_* override these for the remote worker) ──
ALBEDO_S3_ENDPOINT=url
ALBEDO_S3_BUCKET=bucket
# secret
ALBEDO_S3_ACCESS_KEY=
# secret
ALBEDO_S3_SECRET_KEY=

# ── Model storage ──
# secret
HF_TOKEN=
# secret
HIPPIUS_HUB_TOKEN=
# Base cache dir; CV_MODEL_CACHE_DIR and the per-service *_MODEL_CACHE_DIR fall back to it.
ALBEDO_MODEL_CACHE_DIR=path

# ── Model validation / OpenSearch ──
ALBEDO_OPENSEARCH_USER=
# secret
ALBEDO_OPENSEARCH_PASSWORD=
# secret — HMAC key for the dedup weight fingerprint (>= 32 bytes; or a 0600 file)
ALBEDO_DEDUP_SECRET=
ALBEDO_DEDUP_SECRET_FILE=path
# local checkout of the seed model the fingerprint canonicalizes against
ALBEDO_DEDUP_REF_DIR=path
# GPU index for the fingerprint pass; false = shadow mode (verdicts stored, never enforced)
ALBEDO_DEDUP_GPU=6
ALBEDO_DEDUP_ENFORCE=true
# which reject reasons may actually fault a miner when ENFORCE is true; anything else is
# logged only. Exact-copy reasons are safe from day one; the five heuristic reasons
# (LINEAR-COMBO, NOISE-COPY, NOISED-COPY, SPARSE-EDIT, TRIVIAL-EDIT) want calibration on
# real traffic first. "*" enforces everything.
ALBEDO_DEDUP_ENFORCE_REASONS=COPY,OWN-COPY,NOISE-COPY,NOISED-COPY

# ── King HF uploader ──
# secret
ALBEDO_KING_HF_DATABASE_URL=
# secret
ALBEDO_KING_HF_TOKEN=
ALBEDO_KING_HF_NAMESPACE=namespace
ALBEDO_KING_HF_EVAL_DIR=path
ALBEDO_KING_HF_WORK_DIR=path

# ── Monitor / dashboard ──
# secret
TAOSTATS_API_KEY=

# ── Sanity pre-eval: GPU worker ──
# secret; also the dispatcher-side default for SANITY_DISPATCH_REMOTE_AUTH_TOKEN
SANITY_REMOTE_AUTH_TOKEN=token
SANITY_REMOTE_GPU_IDS=0,1,2,3
SANITY_REMOTE_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE=1
SANITY_REMOTE_DATA_PARALLEL_SIZE=4
SANITY_REMOTE_DATA_PARALLEL_SIZE_LOCAL=4
SANITY_REMOTE_MODEL_CACHE_DIR=path
SANITY_REMOTE_VLLM_COMPILE_CACHE_DIR=path

# ── Sanity pre-eval: dispatcher (backend host) ──
SANITY_DISPATCH_DATASET_MANIFEST_PATH=path
SANITY_DISPATCH_DATASET_ROOT=path

# ── Sanity pre-eval: SSH tunnel ──
ALBEDO_SANITY_GPU_HOST_USER=user
ALBEDO_SANITY_GPU_HOST_SSH_HOST=host
ALBEDO_SANITY_GPU_HOST_SSH_PORT=port

# ── Repo-context grounding service (eval GPU host) ──
ALBEDO_REPO_CONTEXT_CACHE_DIR=path
ALBEDO_REPO_CONTEXT_DATASET_ROOT=path
ALBEDO_REPO_CONTEXT_PM2_SCRIPT=path
# secret; bare fallback for ALBEDO_REPO_CONTEXT_GITHUB_TOKEN
GITHUB_TOKEN=

# ── Weight setter (validator wallet) ──
ALBEDO_WEIGHT_COLDKEY=
ALBEDO_WEIGHT_HOTKEY=
# Only set if the wallet is not under ~/.bittensor/wallets.
ALBEDO_WEIGHT_WALLET_PATH=

# ── King chat (chat_to_king; pre-eval GPU host) ──
# secret; falls back to ALBEDO_EVAL_DATABASE_URL
KING_CHAT_DATABASE_URL=
KING_CHAT_GPU_IDS=4,5,6,7
KING_CHAT_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE=4
KING_CHAT_MODELS_DIR=path
# secret; OpenWebUI session secret (stable across restarts)
WEBUI_SECRET_KEY=

# ── dataset_creator (scripts/dataset_creator) ──
# secret
DATASET_CREATOR_DB_URL=
# secret; falls back to HF_TOKEN
DATASET_CREATOR_HF_TOKEN=
DATASET_CREATOR_DATA_DIR=path
DATASET_CREATOR_EVAL_ARTIFACTS_DIR=path
DATASET_CREATOR_HF_REPO=namespace/repo

# ── Third-party runtime vars set on the GPU boxes (not read by albedo code; do not prune) ──
# PATH, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, CUDA_HOME, CUDA_PATH, NVCC_APPEND_FLAGS,
# OPENBLAS/OMP/MKL/NUMEXPR/VECLIB_MAXIMUM/BLIS_NUM_THREADS, TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM,
# TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR, TRITON_CACHE_DIR, HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET

# ── Optional overrides (defaults live in code; uncomment only to deviate) ──
# CHAIN_POLL_INTERVAL_S=2
# CHAIN_START_BLOCK=0
# IGNORE_COMMITS_TO_BLOCK=0
# ALBEDO_EVAL_WORKER_ID=eval-dispatcher
# ALBEDO_EVAL_API_HOST=0.0.0.0
# ALBEDO_EVAL_API_PORT=8080
# ALBEDO_EVAL_ARTIFACT_BUCKET=bucket
# ALBEDO_EVAL_ARTIFACT_PREFIX=s3://bucket/prefix
# ALBEDO_JUDGE_API_HOST=127.0.0.1
# ALBEDO_JUDGE_API_PORT=8091
# ALBEDO_TUNNEL_BACKEND_LOCAL_GPU_PORT=18090
# ALBEDO_TUNNEL_BACKEND_LOCAL_REPO_CONTEXT_PORT=18093
# ALBEDO_SANITY_TUNNEL_LOCAL_PORT=19100
# ALBEDO_REMOTE_EVAL_API_HOST=0.0.0.0
# ALBEDO_REMOTE_EVAL_API_PORT=8090
# ALBEDO_REMOTE_HOST_ROLE=EVAL
# ALBEDO_REMOTE_GPU_COUNT=8
# ALBEDO_REMOTE_FREE_GPU_COUNT=8
# ALBEDO_REMOTE_PREVIOUS_KING_GPU_IDS=0,1,2,3
# ALBEDO_REMOTE_CHALLENGER_GPU_IDS=4,5,6,7
# ALBEDO_REMOTE_UPLOAD_ARTIFACTS=true
# ALBEDO_REMOTE_SCORING_BATCH_CONCURRENCY=128
